reason: Survives the feasibility lens, with repairs. (1) COMPUTE, measured on 44b6_12dfb391 on the laptop: reading a zarr frame (one chunk = one 64x256x256 uint16 frame) takes 0.036 s; the 3x7x7 max filter plus p99.5 takes 0.32 s on CPU; each frame gives 219 anchors (204 unique hashes); hashing takes 2 ms. For a hidden test of about 130 videos x 100 frames that is about 8 min of reading plus about 1 min on the GPU (max_pool3d), or about 18 min on 4 CPU processes. The anchor table is about 3M rows. The research note's '<5 min' is optimistic; about 10-20 min is realistic. That is still trivial against the 12 h rerun limit, since current scoring takes 2-6 h. Lab Step A on 199 videos takes about 30 min on 4 Kaggle CPU processes. (2) REPLAYABILITY: the splice is a pure function of the per-video final graphs plus the registration offsets. Tails exist for all 199 videos (npz with node_id, t, float zyx in voxels, src, dst, edge_prob), so the lab can replay it exactly without touching the detector or the edge network. The exp48 (lp030 + divinsert) tails must first be built on the Kaggle lab; the local lp030 predictions folder is empty. (3) COMPLEXITY is lower than feared. Copy multiplicity per unique multi-copy GT edge is 2 copies for 2,133 edges and 3 copies for 36; none has more than 3 (oc_mult.py). 84 of the +89 simulated FN units come from 2-copy edges, so pairwise splicing with the argmax owner is enough and no multi-copy conflict solver is needed. (4) CSV ROUNDING is harmless. With tail positions rounded to integer voxels, as write_test_submission does, the concordant-TP copy-to-copy distance is median 0.91 um: 88.8% are within 2.5 um (89.7% with float coordinates) and the nearest node is the matched node in 98.4% of cases. A standalone last cell that reads submission.csv therefore works. (5) NO CONFLICT with the upstream stages. The pass runs after relink, gap closing, safe divisions, leaf prune, DaughterNet insertion and linefit. It skips forks and leaves 6bba-type videos untouched. It can be the notebook's last cell (after cell 13, which may rewrite submission.csv), with a try/except fallback. Cell 12 already swaps TEST_DIR to TRAIN_DIR, so a positive smoke test on a known overlapping train pair (12dfb391/3a861e03, offset (-86,6,-114,75)) is cheap. The dummy test pair gives only a negative smoke test. Real feasibility risks, all repairable: (a) 11% of concordant-TP node pairs fall outside 2.5 um, so a 2.5 um correspondence creates spurious non-agree components (churn and seams) wherever both copies are right. (b) The standard lab gate (each embryo >= +0.001, wins on >= 55% of videos per embryo) cannot pass by construction, because 6bba is exactly 0. A bespoke gate has to be pre-registered, and 75% of the simulated gain sits in leak group 0. (c) The public LB shows 3 decimals, so a real but small change of 0.0003-0.0005 is invisible. 'Any LB change proves overlap' is therefore not a reliable diagnostic. (d) Frozen frames can give exact voxel equality at dt +-1. (e) Hidden-test filenames may not carry the embryo prefix. Engineering is about 1-1.5 days (registration ~150 LOC, splice ~250 LOC, lab kernel reuse), which fits before 29 Sep. The idea is feasible but small: it cannot move the 0.948 -> 0.97 target.
fix_if_any: (i) Register by exact-content hashing on the GPU (max_pool3d) inside a final standalone cell. Re-read the test zarrs (about 8 min); do not modify the detection loop. Skip hash buckets larger than about 10 entries (saturated or flat patches). Take the vote mode, then require >= 99.9% voxel equality on 3 frames spread over the overlap, >= 5 overlapping frames and >= 5% spatial overlap; this also handles frozen frames at dt +-1. Do not depend on filename prefixes: exact equality makes cross-prefix pairs safe, and prefix hits are only logged. (ii) Define 'agree' at track level (the same successor through a correspondence of <= 3.5-4 um), or use a 3.5 um node correspondence. At 2.5 um, 11% of doubly-correct nodes would be spliced for nothing. Report the number of components replaced where both copies were TP (the churn). (iii) Splice pairwise with the argmax owner; 3-copy cases are 36 edges and can simply be skipped in v1. Treat a component as a fork if it touches a fork parent or a fork child. (iv) Place the cell after cell 13, wrap it in try/except that restores the original csv, and add a DEBUG flag that runs it on 2-3 overlapping train videos through the cell-12 TEST_DIR swap. (v) Pre-register the gate before the lab run: 44b6 per-embryo delta >= +0.002, a sign test over leak groups (>= 7 of the non-zero groups positive), the result without group 0 reported, 6bba bit-identical, node ratio <= +0.3%, division TP/FP unchanged. (vi) Replace the 'LB change = diagnostic' logic with the optional bit-probe: the kernel raises if at least 1 exact-overlap test pair exists, needs about 15 min of runtime and uses 1 slot with user approval. Run it before engineering the splice, and build the splice only if it errors.
realistic_public_gain: About +0.001 in expectation: 0 if the public embryo is tiled like 6bba, about +0.002-0.003 if it is 44b6-like, after seam and churn losses against a +0.004 ceiling. Private is similar. It is feasible (1-1.5 days, 10-20 min of kernel runtime) and low-harm, but it is a small add-on and cannot close the gap to 0.97. The bit-probe (1 slot) settles whether to build it at all.
